newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Volume rose to 3.4 billion yuan from 1.6 billion on Tuesday, with the seven-day contract the most active.
Traders said the rates made a technical rebound today after yesterday's falls, with state banks becoming net borrowers in order to cover short-term money needs at the end of the year.

But short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, reduced their trading, a sign that the overall need of funds by financial institutions was falling with the approach of the year-end, they said.
"With demand for funds shrinking, the rates may go down slowly in the next few trading days," said a trader.
